title: PIL – Flotation Train 1 and 2 Conditioning Power Alarms

fields.latestPosition: Email sent 30/07 requesting the change be placed on hold for further review.
fields.statusConflict: Form priority 2 – Within 1 Week vs register 3 – Next Fortnight
fields.why: Conditioning power on Train 1 and Train 2 recently dropped to levels that impact flotation performance. There are no alarms on these values to indicate operation below setpoint.
fields.design:
- Alarm when the 30-minute average PV is 7.5% below SP
- Train 1: 235-AG-502-PWR-M3, 235-AG-002-PWR-M3, 235-AG-003-PWR-M3
- Train 2: 235-PY-3637, 235-PY-3638, 235-PY-3639
- Create Train 1 faceplates (Train 2 already has them)
- No trip to be implemented
- Correct the 235-TK-004 power trend naming (shows 235-AG-002-PWR-M3 instead of 235-AG-003-PWR-M3)
fields.impact: CROs will receive low conditioning power alarms on both trains and have new Train 1 faceplates.
